office_hours.text: Monday–Saturday 09:00–17:00, Sunday 09:00–13:00; lunch 12:30–13:30. Weekday public holidays closed after morning Mass; weekend public holidays normal hours.

good_to_know.text: Do not leave vehicles after morning Mass on weekday public holidays: all gates close.
Columbarium Monday–Saturday 08:00–20:00, Sunday 06:00–19:00; last visitor switches off lights/air-conditioning.
Crying room at church-hall entrance allows parent and noisy child to see/participate; not intended for whole families. Other family members should sit in main hall where possible.

Non-Catholic visitors welcome at Mass; Communion reserved to baptised Catholics. Modest dress, quiet/reverent conduct; Mass approximately 1h15m. Visitors generally not asked to stand/identify themselves; no obligation to contribute money.

church_hours.text: Church Hall Monday 17:00–19:00, Tuesday–Saturday 08:30–19:00, Sunday 06:00–18:30. Weekday public holidays close after morning Mass.

public_holidays.text: Weekday public holidays: 07:30 only, no 18:30 Mass. Church closes after morning Mass; remove vehicles before gates close.

getting_there.text: From Woodlands Integrated Transport Hub use Berth 12, buses 912/912B/912M/913M; 912 most direct. Do not use 912A/912 from Berth 7. Alight fifth stop excluding interchange, cross road and turn left. Bus 967 may also serve the route. Driving: SLE exit Woodlands Ave 2, left into Ave 1, church on right after petrol station.

Limited parking at Level 1 basement and Level 2. Alternatives Woodgrove Centre opposite and HDB carparks behind. Do not park along Avenue 1. Church carparks may close for major feasts/solemnities/events.

accessibility.text: Wheelchair ramp from Level 2 to church hall; lifts from basement carpark to Level 2 foyer, upper church levels and Annex/Fireplace.

languages.text: Malayalam 19:30 on Saturday before first Sunday; Tamil 19:30 on Saturday before second Sunday; Tagalog 19:30 on Saturday before fourth Sunday. Check dated bulletin. These cannot safely be represented as fixed nth Saturdays.

sacraments.text: Infant baptism page’s next date is stale (27 January 2024). Parents attend both preparation sessions, godparents second. Submit parish form, parents’ church marriage certificate (ask office if unavailable), child birth certificate, Catholic godparents’ baptism extracts. Ask parish for current dates.

Call Parish Office with homebound person’s name, address, contacts and care needs. Assigned minister contacts family to agree schedule, bringing Communion after Mass. Request anointing or reconciliation through office or minister.

Notify parish at least 12 months ahead; arrange priest interview, current baptism extracts (six-month validity), birth certificates, MPC/EE certificate, civil certificate if applicable. No wedding Mass Sundays, obligation days, Lent or Advent. Inform priest of religious differences or previous marriage.

Rehearsal Tuesday–Friday 20:00–21:00 within two weeks of wedding, by advance booking; no air-conditioning unless $150 paid. Choir request six months ahead; Communion minister numbers two months ahead; AV/servers/lectors support three weeks ahead. Parish does not print wedding booklets.
Chinese RCIA series began 5 July 2026; registration link https://bit.ly/4sOyBBE?r=qr. Facilitator volunteers can express interest at https://bit.ly/RCIAFACILITATOR.
